passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto that appear elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. See “Risk Factors” elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of certain risks associated with our business. The following discussion contains forward-looking statements. Forward-looking statements give our current expectations or forecasts of future events. You can identify these statements by the fact that they do not relate strictly to historical or current facts. The use of words such as “anticipate,” “estimate,” “expect,” “project,” “intend,” “plan,” “believe,” and other words and terms of similar meaning in connection with any discussion of future operating or financial performance. From time to time, we also may provide forward-looking statements in other materials we release to the public. Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this Item 7 “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” to “Symbotic,” “we,” “us,” “our” and the “Company” are intended to mean the business and operations of Symbotic Inc. This section provides an analysis of our financial results for the year ended September 27, 2025 as compared to the year ended September 28, 2024. For the discussion and analysis covering the year ended September 28, 2024 compared to the year ended September 30, 2023, please refer to the “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended September 28, 2024, as filed with the SEC on December 4, 2024. 48 Table of Contents Company Overview Our vision is to make the supply chain work better for everyone. We do this by developing, commercializing, and deploying innovative and comprehensive technology solutions that dramatically improve supply chain operations. We automate the processing of pallets, cases and items (known as eaches) in warehouses. Our robotic based automation systems, which include hardware and essential software, move, store and sort cases and eaches in warehouses. Our systems are operational in a number of the world’s largest retailers, including Walmart, wholesale distributors, including C&S Wholesale Grocers, and are being deployed in GreenBox Systems LLC (“GreenBox”), our warehouse-as-a-service joint venture. We have spent significant time working closely with our customers to develop, test and refine our technology. We have approximately $22.5 billion of backlog as of September 27, 2025, of which our agreements with Walmart and GreenBox comprise the vast majority. We have devoted significant funds and resources to date in developing and diversifying our systems and related applications. Our systems are designed to increase efficiency, speed and flexibility of the supply chain by using proprietary robotics and A.I.-powered software for the movement and storage of goods. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: In evaluating our business and the Company, you should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes and in the section titled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.” The occurrence of one or more of the events or circumstances described in these risk factors, alone or in combination with other events or circumstances, may have a material adverse effect on our business, reputation, revenue, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects, in which case the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. The material and other risks and uncertainties described below and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are not intended to be exhaustive and are not the only ones we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial may also impair our business, reputation, revenue, financial condition, results of operations and future prospects. Risk Factor Summary Risks Related to Our Business, Operations and Industry, including: • We are a growing company with a limited operating history and a history of losses. We have not been profitable historically and we may not achieve or maintain profitability in the near term or at all, and it is difficult to evaluate our future prospects and the risks and challenges we may encounter. • We depend heavily on our larger customers, and therefore, our success is heavily dependent on their ability to grow their businesses and their adoption of our system. • C&S Wholesale Grocers, an important customer, is our affiliate. Despite our affiliation with C&S Wholesale Grocers, there is no guarantee that it will continue to be a customer beyond the term of its current contracts with us. • We may fail to realize anticipated benefits of the GreenBox joint venture, or it may disrupt our ongoing operations or result in operating difficulties, liabilities and expenses, harm our business, and negatively impact our results of operations. • Our operating results and financial condition may fluctuate from period to period, which could make our future operating results difficult to predict or cause our operating results to fall below analysts’ and investors’ expectations. 17 Table of Contents • Complex technology will need to be developed and implemented, both in-house and in coordination with our vendors and suppliers, for us to successfully produce and integrate our systems with our customers’ existing warehouses, and there can be no assurance that they will be successfully developed and implemented. • We are required to assess our internal control over financial reporting and our management has identified a material weakness. If our remediation of the material weakness is not effective, or we identify additional material weaknesses or other adverse findings in the future, our ability to report our financial condition or results of operations accurately or timely or prevent fraud may be adverse

credit_strengths.text: Revenue has compounded rapidly across the three-year trend, with the latest fiscal year materially above the prior period, evidencing strong demand for Symbotic's warehouse automation systems and a growing installed base. The disclosed backlog, dominated by Walmart and GreenBox, provides multi-year revenue visibility that supports forward cash generation, although customer concentration remains a structural feature of this growth profile.

Operating cash flow swung sharply positive in the latest fiscal year, reversing the prior-year outflow, and comfortably covers the modest current-liability base. Cash on the balance sheet is substantial relative to current liabilities, and the current ratio sits below the sector median, indicating liquidity is adequate but not abundant for a capital-intensive deployment model.

key_risks.text: The company has a limited operating history and a history of losses, and management explicitly states it may not achieve or maintain profitability in the near term or at all. Operating income remains negative and the operating margin is below the sector median, so the path to sustained positive EBITDA depends on execution against a concentrated, capital-intensive deployment pipeline.

Customer concentration is acute: Walmart and GreenBox comprise the vast majority of backlog, and C&S Wholesale Grocers, an affiliate, is an important customer with no guarantee of continuing beyond current contracts. Loss or deferral by any major customer would materially impair revenue, cash conversion and the ability to service obligations.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: No funded debt is tagged on the balance sheet, and the debt note indicates the issuer may have no borrowings; only an operating lease liability is disclosed. With no interest expense captured, interest coverage cannot be computed, but the absence of funded debt means debt service is not currently a binding constraint on cash flow.

Operating cash flow is positive and cash balances are meaningful, but free cash flow cannot be assessed because capital expenditure is not tagged, and the Altman Z double-prime zone is Distress. Analyst judgement: liquidity runway, not leverage, is the relevant metric, and capex disclosure is a material gap for assessing true cash conversion.

overall_credit_view.text: Symbotic is a growing automation provider with strong revenue momentum, a large backlog and no tagged funded debt, but it remains loss-making at the operating line with a negative EBITDA proxy. The indicative financial risk profile is not meaningful on leverage; analyst judgement is that liquidity and execution risk, not debt service, drive the credit view.

Key monitorables are customer concentration, GreenBox joint-venture execution, the disclosed material weakness in internal control, and the missing capex and interest expense data that prevent a full free-cash-flow and coverage assessment. Analyst judgement: the credit is stable but speculative, contingent on converting backlog into profitable, cash-generative deployments.

credit_strengths.text: 收入於三年趨勢中快速複合增長，最近一個財政年度大幅高於上一期間，印證市場對 Symbotic 倉庫自動化系統的強勁需求及不斷擴大的已安裝基礎。已披露的積壓訂單以 Walmart 及 GreenBox 為主，提供多年收入可見度，支持未來現金產生，儘管客戶集中度仍是此增長模式的結構性特徵。
營運現金流於最近一個財政年度大幅轉正，扭轉上一年的流出，並足以輕鬆覆蓋規模不大的流動負債基礎。資產負債表上的現金相對於流動負債而言相當充裕，而流動比率低於行業中位數，顯示流動性充足但對於資本密集的部署模式而言並不寬裕。

key_risks.text: 公司營運歷史有限，且過往錄得虧損，管理層明確表示可能無法在短期內或根本無法實現或維持盈利。經營利潤仍為負數，經營利潤率低於行業中位數，因此實現持續正 EBITDA 的路徑取決於能否在集中且資本密集的部署管道上執行。
客戶集中度極為嚴重：Walmart 及 GreenBox 佔積壓訂單的絕大部分，而關聯公司 C&S Wholesale Grocers 為重要客戶，且不保證現有合約之後會繼續。任何主要客戶流失或延遲將重大損害收入、現金轉換及履行義務的能力。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 資產負債表上並無標記有融資債務，債務附註顯示發行人可能並無借款；僅披露一項經營租賃負債。由於並無捕捉到利息支出，無法計算利息覆蓋率，但沒有融資債務意味著償債目前並非現金流的約束條件。
營運現金流為正數，現金結餘亦有意義，但由於並無標記資本開支，無法評估自由現金流，且 Altman Z 雙重質數區間為 Distress。分析師判斷：相關指標是流動性跑道而非槓桿，而資本開支披露是評估真實現金轉換的重大缺口。

overall_credit_view.text: Symbotic 是一家增長中的自動化供應商，收入勢頭強勁、積壓訂單龐大且並無標記融資債務，但在經營層面仍錄得虧損，EBITDA 代理指標為負數。指示性財務風險狀況在槓桿方面並不具意義；分析師判斷，驅動信貸觀點的是流動性及執行風險，而非償債。
主要監察事項為客戶集中度、GreenBox 合資企業的執行、已披露的內部控制重大缺陷，以及缺失的資本開支及利息支出數據，導致無法全面評估自由現金流及覆蓋率。分析師判斷：該信貸穩定但屬投機性質，取決於能否將積壓訂單轉化為具盈利及現金產生的部署。
